Risk tiers: Low (0-3) 19 patients, Moderate (4-6) 30, High (7-10) 19, Very High (11+) 3. Avg risk score 5.2/14. 22 patients (31%) in high/very-high tier. 49 GTCS patients (69%), 20 drug-resistant (28.2%), 25 non-adherent (35.2%). GTCS x drug-resistance matrix, score histogram, gender breakdown, per-patient sortable table with top factors, high-risk alert panel with clinical action checklist. 5-tab frontend (Overview / Risk Factors / Per Patient / High-Risk Alerts / Definitions).
